help.customer: Linking a customer gives its users (Customer Users) access: they can view, download and comment on this PoC's Reports, and nothing else. They sign up with the customer's name and the access key you generate on the Customers page. Linking is optional and can be done or changed later, in Edit details.
help.comments: Your assessment of the PoC: overall evaluation, strengths observed, limitations, open items and next steps agreed with the customer. The text is printed in the Report, in the SE Comments section, exactly as written.
help.verdictPending: Pending: the PoC has no decision yet. The Report shows the verdict as pending until it is set.
help.verdict.approved.meaning: The solution fully meets the technical and operational requirements defined in the test plan and test book.
help.verdict.approved.detail: The product demonstrated the ability to close critical gaps identified in the Identify phase of NIST, CIS, and others. There is confidence that the tool can be integrated into the SOC automation pipeline without excessive friction and ensures a high level of threat detection from the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
help.verdict.approved.align: Validated as an effective control to mitigate specific risks. Complies with Continuous Monitoring and Asset Protection requirements.
help.verdict.conditional.meaning: The tool delivers the promised value, but there are external dependencies, infrastructure limitations, or need for heavy customization.
help.verdict.conditional.detail: Represents a residual risk that must be accepted or mitigated by other compensatory controls. May indicate that the solution requires more SOC man-hours (H/H) than originally planned for tuning and incident response.
help.verdict.conditional.align: Points to the need for Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&M). According to CIS Controls, it may suggest that while the technical control exists, governance over it (e.g., log management or integrations) is not yet mature.
help.verdict.rejected.meaning: The solution failed critical success criteria, showed instability, or does not integrate into the current security ecosystem.
help.verdict.rejected.detail: Strategic decision to avoid capital waste (CapEx/OpEx) on a tool that does not reduce organizational risk or may introduce new vulnerabilities (e.g., high false-positive rate causing alert fatigue).
help.verdict.rejected.align: Based on the Defense in Depth principle. If the tool does not strengthen the security posture or fails to detect common MITRE ATT&CK framework tactics, it is discarded to prioritize more efficient investments.
help.effortGoal: Goal: show the customer, with the real PoC figures, how much manual analyst work Stellar Cyber avoids by correlating alerts into cases. The result appears in the Executive Report, in the "effort avoided" question of the detection story.
help.effortAlert: Triage per alert/case ({v} min): time for an analyst to look at a single alert or at an already correlated case.
help.effortInv: Investigation per case ({ch} min Critical/High, {m} min Medium, {l} min Low): time to investigate each case. It is the same with or without correlation, so it is not part of the savings.
help.effortMonth: Hours per analyst-month ({v} h): turns the hours saved into analysts (FTE).
help.effortCalc: Calculation: without correlation, triage = alerts × {a} min; with Stellar Cyber, triage = cases × {a} min. The difference is the triage avoided, shown in hours, as a % of manual triage and in analyst-months.
help.effortDefaults: The current values are the defaults. Change them if the customer's SOC has its own times: the Report then states that the premises were set by the SE.
sync.licenseWindow: Assets and licensing volume are only available for the last {days} days. This period starts earlier, so the Report will lack those figures for the days outside that window.
